text:
sre-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: GPU capacity alarm for model=redwood-llm-v2 in us-west-2 (prod). Queue growth detected. root cause suspected: scheduling failures / MIG fragmentation. Assigned to @amanda

amanda: Acked. I'm on it. Seeing sustained queue length -> 1.2k requests, 30% of requests being throttled. Autoscaler attempted 3 scale actions, all failed with placement errors.

amanda: Quick signal dump:
```
Queue size: 1243
Throttled reqs: 317
Autoscaler attempts: 3 (t=+00:05, +00:12, +00:18)
Last error: binpack_no_fit: pod="inference/redwood-llm-v2" reason="no nodes fit requested MIG profile"
MIG usage: total GPUs reported: 64, but usable slots: 44 (fragmented)
```

ryan: Can you paste the scheduler logs? I want the specific node/plug mismatch.

amanda: grabbing logs now. shows repeated failure because pods request 40GB MIG slices and nodes are mixtures of 40GB and 16GB MIG partitions. Binpacking can't place 40GB pods on nodes that only mostly have 16GB profiles leftover.

amanda: kubectl snippet:
```
$ kubectl get nodes -o wide | egrep "gpu|node-role"
node-a   Ready  gpu=mig-40g,alloc=1/4
node-b   Ready  gpu=mig-16g,alloc=3/4
node-c   Ready  gpu=mig-40g,alloc=2/4
node-d   Ready  gpu=mig-16g,alloc=0/4
```

jess: So we have stranded capacity on node-b (has free 16G partitions) but pods need 40G, hence nothing fits. Autoscaler tried to add nodes but cloud quota prevented new 40G nodes from provisioning?

amanda: Correct. Cloud quota for the 40G GPU SKU is at limit for this account in us-west-2. Autoscaler falls back to adding same class nodes but provisioning API returned 403 quota_exceeded. That combined with fragmentation = stuck.

dinesh: Could we temporarily allow 16G pods (smaller model variant) to run as fallback? We have a quantized redwood-llm-v2-lite that fits 16G. If we switch a percentage of traffic to the 16G model we can drain backlog.

amanda: Good idea. Immediate mitigation suggestions (short list):
- route 40% of new traffic to redwood-llm-v2-lite (16G) for 30m
- reduce default max_batch_size on 40G variant to lower pending memory pressure
- manually scale up 2 x 40G nodes via infra console (request quota increase)
- run a node rebalancer job to consolidate small allocations and free 40G slots

ryan: For rebalancer job, do we have live tool? We can cordon node-b and migrate 16G pods to node-d (free) and then restart kubelet MIG reconciliation to reassign partitions. Risk: pod restarts -> transient errors.

amanda: Low risk if we shift only non-prod-like traffic. Propose we shift non-paying/low-priority requests to lite first. cs-ops, need customer impact note?

cs-ops: Yes. Current impact: increased latency and 10-20% request failures for customers on Dedicated capacity. We're seeing multiple customer tickets and 2 enterprise customers reported degraded SLAs. I'll post a short status on status.redwood.ai and DM account teams. ETA for initial mitigation (routing to lite + batch-size change): 15 minutes.

oncall-ml: Who will own the cloud quota request? That usually needs SOC approval and can take time. We should do immediate software mitigations first.

amanda: I'll open the quota case (cloud-req#76542) and mark as high. Also initiating routing change now.

amanda: Applying config change:
```
PATCH /infra/feature-flags
{ "model_routing": { "redwood-llm-v2": 0.6, "redwood-llm-v2-lite": 0.4 } }
```
applied. Traffic shift started.

jess: Observability: latency p50 from 120ms -> 420ms, p95 1.8s -> 4.2s. Queue length trending down from 1243 -> 480 in last 10m after routing change. Throttles dropping.

amanda: Good. Next: rebalancer plan. I'll schedule a maintenance window for 10m: cordon node-b, drain tolerant pods, run packer to defragment MIG allocations, uncordon. Manual steps:
1) `kubectl cordon node-b`
2) `kubectl drain node-b --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`
3) run /srv/tools/mig-packer --target-mig=40G --consolidate
4) `kubectl uncordon node-b`

ryan: I'll take the cordon/drain and watch for any unexpected evictions. Amanda please make sure the packer has a dry-run first.

amanda: Doing dry-run now. Dry-run shows we can free up 3x 40G slots by migrating 5 pods to node-d and restarting kubelet. If dry-run looks good we'll proceed.

(sre-bot): Incident timeline note: incident opened 1825001234, mitigations applied at +00:20 (traffic routing), in progress: rebalancer job + quota request.

jess: CS update posted. Two customers on Dedicated were impacted with elevated latencies; flagged for manual credit review.

dinesh: After rebalancer completes, we should update autoscaler policy to be fragmentation-aware (prefer new nodes with matching MIG topology and detect mixed partition churn). I'll draft a change: enforce binpack affinity across similar MIG profiles and prefer homogenous nodes for critical models.

amanda: Agree. For immediate safety I'm adding a temporary autoscaler override to allow CPU fallback scaling to keep throughput: `autoscaler.override.allow_cpu_fallback=true`

oncall-ml: Handoff note: I'm taking the on-call from Amanda at +00:45. Amanda — please DM me the current runbook pointer and the cloud request ID.

amanda: DM sent. Cloud case 76542 submitted. Dry-run packer successful. Proceeding with cordon/drain now.

amanda: `kubectl drain node-b` -> draining; 5 pods being evicted (non-critical).

ryan: Watch logs for model startup failures during packing. If the packer reports MIG mismatch we abort and uncordon.

amanda: Packer run: `OK: consolidated 3x40G slots freed`

amanda: Uncordon node-b. Cluster now shows 47 usable 40G slots. Queue now 120 -> 60 in last 6m. Throttles nearly zero.

jess: Great. I'm updating incident channel and downstream threads. Suggest we keep autoscaler override and routing for 2 hours while cloud quota is increased. Then revert after verification.

dinesh: Filing a follow-up action: OWNER=eng-runtime, SUMMARY=Make autoscaler fragmentation-aware + add MIG-aware binpacking policy. ETA 2 weeks for prototype, 6 weeks for rollout.

amanda: Final customer impact summary for postmortem: 2 enterprise customers degraded (latency & occasional errors) for ~1.5 hours. Immediate mitigations reduced impact; full root cause: MIG partition fragmentation + quota limit prevented provisioning compatible nodes.

oncall-ml: I'm on watch. Please escalate to me if queue grows >300 again. I'll own next 2h. Amanda, thanks handoff.

amanda: Thanks team. Postmortem draft assigned to jess. Closing on-call handover. 

(sre-bot): Incident status: mitigated -> monitoring. Follow-up actions created: FR-342 (autoscaler improvements), OP-98 (quota playbook), DOC-211 (runbook updates).
